[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 30
- Description: PII Event Envelope — design doc, CRF plan §11.10 cross-ref, + handoff registration
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1259
  
  Details:
  Work done in Telegram topic 31842 ("PII Event Envelope (encrypt + commit)"), spun out of the CRF-anapu payout work (thread 30026) at Gary's request.
  
  WHAT SHIPPED
  - plans/PII_EVENT_ENVELOPE.md — 143-line design doc for encrypting PII-bearing DAO events at the emitter (AES-256-GCM + RSA-OAEP-wrapped data key) and emitting a SHA-256 commitment in the clear, so a submission is verifiable WITHOUT disclosure. Covers: the hybrid envelope shape; separation of existence/intensity/selective-disclosure properties; the P4 (§11.6) design fork; the hard parts that must be solved before code (key custody Fernet-vault vs AWS KMS, escrow/recovery 2-of-3 governor wrap, multi-recipient, signing≠encryption key separation, canonical JSON); test obligations; and an E1–E5 rollout with E5 gated on human.
  - CRF_ANAPU_SUNMINT_COHORT_PROPOSAL.md §11.10 — cross-reference pinning the envelope workstream to the CRF payout work so the §11.2 "privacy by location" consequence is defused.
  - handoffs/HANDOFF_MANIFEST.md row + regenerated handoffs/index.json — the workstream registered at thread 31842.
  - Gary's 2026-09-18 refinement applied: the envelope applies at the PUBLIC-JSON boundary, not the browser → no browser key custody, and cfr-anapu#11 (P4) is NOT forked (proceeds independently, merged + live).
  
  CRITICAL NOTE (this is the whole point of the thread)
  The design is NOT yet implemented — no code exists. §11.2's "the intake must stay private" consequence remains LIVE until E2/E3 land. Key custody (KMS vs vault), escrow, and key separation are open decisions awaiting the governor's option pick (§9 open questions in the plan).
  
  Also verified: P4 (cfr-anapu#11) merged and live on cfr.truesight.me; the [#PAYOUT REGISTRATION] exclusion from public JSON generators is the outstanding safety item tracked in the CRF plan.
  
  DELIVERABLE STATE
  - Plan file + manifest row survive this topic (the Telegram thread is only the tracking surface).
  - Workstream state: draft — design proposed; awaiting governor's option pick. No code yet.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 50.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
